method: Copied recorded JSON/CSV inputs into an isolated directory, regenerated outputs with the PowerShell scripts at reference_revision, then compared the Dart outputs recursively. Object key order is ignored; arrays retain order. Markdown compares after BOM removal, newline normalization and trimming surrounding whitespace.
numeric_comparison: Exact numeric equality, with absolute tolerance 1e-12 only for unequal floating-point values. Integers have no tolerance.
exclusions: calibration-flutter has no run.json or failure.json and produces no analysis output in the old script.
Existing summary JSONs were regenerated with the current reference scripts; two legacy summaries omitted implementations, so their Rust/Dart selection was passed explicitly.
